name: Inspection
groups: Unit environment and equipment (built, not reachable)

entryPoints.label: Search or scan from the dock

flow: tap Scan ear tag or Search
tap the note card or Add / Edit pen note
tick pigs or pens, tap Actions
tap the unit name (not drawn today)

notes.purpose: The worker walks one unit pen by pen, sees every pig with its stage, health tags and feed change, picks pigs or pens, and records on the spot.
states: Nothing selected: the dock offers Go to pen, Scan ear tag and Search.
One or more pigs or pens selected: the dock shows Clear, "Selected · N", View selected and Actions.
Lens All, Health or Feed (counts under each label).
Filters on: a strip names them with Clear; no pig matches: "No pigs match" with Show all pigs.
Before check-in: "Finish walk" and last check-in 06:40. After check-in: "Check in again" and last check-in 09:41.
Opened from Home: the back arrow returns to Home with the unit kept; opened alone: it opens a one-row Today sheet.

elements.name: Header · title
elements.logic: Fixed page title.

elements.name: Header · unit
elements.logic: Shows "Unit N" when the page was opened from Home with a unit (?unit=N), otherwise the sample "Unit 7".

elements.name: Header · Back to Today
elements.logic: Returns to Home when opened from Home (from=home); otherwise opens the sheet "Today · Your work" holding one row "Inspection · Unit 7" with the last check-in time.

elements.name: Header · Finish walk
elements.logic: Text button. Label turns to "Check in again" once checkedIn is true. Opens the Finish walk sheet.

elements.name: Intro · Last check-in
elements.logic: Time is 06:40 until the walk is checked in, then 09:41. The name "G. Hansen" is fixed text for every walk, not the signed-in worker.
elements.source: literal times and name in main()

elements.name: Intro · Log
elements.logic: Opens "This walk": every update recorded since the page loaded, newest first. Empty: "No updates yet".

elements.name: Lens tabs · All / Health / Feed
elements.logic: Count = pigs that pass the active filters and the lens. Health counts a pig with any recorded condition, including ongoing ones that need no action (000281 Arthritis). Feed counts a pig with a feed change (held, stopped, or an adjustment other than 100%) and every pig in a pen whose formula change is due (both D4 pigs).

elements.name: Filter button
elements.logic: Badge = number of active filters among batch, stage, condition, care, manual-feed, health-status. Opens the Filter pigs sheet.

elements.name: Filter strip
elements.shows: e.g. "Batch 20 · Gestating · Fever · Treat in place" and Clear
elements.logic: Only when a filter is on. Care shows its label ("Move to hospital pen"), not its value. Clear resets every filter and the lens.

elements.name: Pen header · name
elements.logic: Pen id and the number of ALL pigs in the pen (not only those the filter shows). Tapping opens the pen sheet. A pen with no matching pig is hidden.

elements.name: Pen header · note icon
elements.shows: note icon next to the name
elements.logic: Shown when the pen has a note (C1 "Close the aisle gate after passing."); only a presence mark, the note text is not on the list.

elements.name: Pen header · feed button
elements.logic: Value = sum of every pig's daily allowance in the pen (base x factor, a held amount, or 0 when stopped) for trough pens, "Ad-lib" for ad-lib pens. Small state under it: "No feed" when every pig is stopped, else "Formula due" when the pen's formula change is due, else "Auto" for station-fed pens, else nothing. Tapping opens the feed editor for the pen.

elements.name: Pen header · pen checkbox
elements.shows: checkbox, indeterminate when some pigs are ticked
elements.logic: Ticking selects the pen AND every pig it shows under the current filters; unticking removes them. Its accessible name states how many pigs are displayed.

elements.name: Pig row · checkbox
elements.logic: Selects the pig only, never its pen.

elements.name: Pig row · ear tag
elements.logic: Bold id; whole row (except the checkbox) opens the pig record.

elements.name: Pig row · meta
elements.logic: Sows: stage name + days in the stage since the stage start (stageStartedAt, else the service date for gestating sows, else farrowing date for lactating); "—" when no start date is known; never falls back to lifetime age. Off-production sows with breedingStatus Open read "Open". Other types (boar, piglet, grower): type + "N days old".

elements.name: Pig row · health tags
elements.logic: One tag per condition, needs-attention ones first. Day text: "Day N" while care is Monitor / Treat in place / Move to hospital pen, "N days" once the care is "No action needed". The care level shows only as an icon and colour (monitor, treatment, hospital) and in the tag tooltip.

elements.name: Pig row · feed tag
elements.logic: After the health tags. +/-% = the pig's factor against 100%; Feed held = fixed amount; No feed = stopped.

elements.name: Pig row · +N
elements.logic: When the tags do not fit one line, the last ones collapse into +N (recomputed after fonts load and on resize); the full list is in the pig record and the row's accessible name.

elements.name: Dock · Go to pen
elements.logic: Shows "Pens" until the list is scrolled, then the pen currently at the top. Opens the pen map.

elements.name: Dock · Scan ear tag / Search
elements.logic: Scan has no camera in the prototype; Search finds by ear tag or pen.

elements.name: Dock · selection
elements.logic: Label joins "N pens" and "N pigs". Actions opens the Actions sheet for the selection.

controls.control: A health tag or the row of a pig with attention
controls.does: same pig record; its needs-attention rows open the finding
opens the feed editor for the pen

controls.control: Pen or pig checkboxes then Actions

edge: A pen whose pigs all fail the filter disappears from the list.
A pen with no pigs matching shows no feed button; a pig with a missing stage start shows "Gestation · —".
Ad-lib pens show "Ad-lib" instead of a weight and have no individual allowance.
Selecting a pen after the filter changed selects only the pigs displayed.
rules: "Selection is not an inspection result" (page footer): ticking pigs records nothing.
"A pig checkbox does not implicitly select its pen" (ASTRA-INSPECTION-ROUND-3).
Feed is guidance, not a completion checklist: no "record as done" on feed.
Care is the only editable condition state; attention is derived from it (ASTRA-BULK-ACTIONS).
issues: The label "Health 4" counts pigs with ANY condition, including ongoing ones that need no action (Arthritis); a worker reads it as "pigs to check". It does not say what it counts.
"Feed 3" mixes two different things: pigs with an individual feed change (1) and every pig in a pen whose formula change is due (2 in D4, who have no change of their own).
The pen header count "3 pigs" counts all pigs while the rows show only the filtered pigs; the feed total likewise covers all pigs.

The care level (Monitor / Treat in place / Move to hospital pen) is shown only by icon and colour on the row; the words appear only in a tooltip, so a gloved worker cannot tell Monitor from Treat in place.
The pig's stage, days and batch repeat in the row, the pig record header and the pig record body.
The author "G. Hansen" and the times 06:40 / 09:41 are fixed text; "Last check-in" is not tied to a real check-in.
The pen-level "issue" banner (Feeder low · 06:40) is in the code but the sample data clears it, so it never shows; the 2nd-round study removed the feeder alert.
Filters for health status (needs attention / no action needed) and manual-feed have state and a strip label but no control sets them.
Search, review and the Scan list show the raw stage "Gestating" while the row shows "Gestation · 40 days".

notes.purpose: Shows how the stage and elapsed days read on the row, including a sow that is open (not in pig) and ongoing arthritis.
states: Same as the walk. 000312 is Off production and open; 000281 has Arthritis; a batch 21 "Off production" exists for 000312.

elements.name: Pig row · meta for 000312
elements.logic: Off-production sows whose breedingStatus is Open read "Open" instead of the stage; days = walk date minus the stage start (4 Sep 2026).

elements.name: Pig row · meta for the other sows
elements.logic: Days since stageStartedAt; "—" when no date; never the animal's lifetime age.

elements.name: Lens counts
elements.logic: Same rule as the walk.

edge: A sow with no stage start and no service date shows "Gestation · —" (000306).
"Open" is shown only when the status is explicit, never inferred from a missing service date.
rules: Duration never falls back to lifetime age (comment in the code).
issues: The same walk as inspection.walk with one extra batch; the preset has no visible difference except the Open row.
The row says "Gestation · 40 days" (days in stage) while the pig record says "Last service · 40 days ago" (days since service): two clocks that look alike and can differ.

screens.name: Boars and piglets in the list

notes.purpose: Shows that the list is not only sows: boars and piglets sit in their own pens and read by type and age.
states: Two pens are added: B1 (boar B-024, ad-lib "Boar feed") and P1 (piglet 001104, ad-lib "Piglet starter"). All = 9.

elements.name: Pig row · meta for a boar
elements.logic: Non-sows show type + age in days; age comes from p.age, else from the birth date.

elements.name: Pig row · meta for a piglet
elements.logic: Same rule.

elements.name: Pen header · feed button
elements.logic: Both pens are ad-lib, so no weight and no feed editing.

controls.does: opens its record, whose detail block changes with the type (Boar breeding, Piglet growth)

edge: Backfat can be recorded only for sows and gilts; the bulk form lists boars and piglets as "Sows and gilts only".
rules: Detail blocks follow the animal type (typeDetails).
issues: The sample piglet is a single pig in a pen of one; the real unit would hold litters as groups, which the walk cannot show yet.

screens.name: Pen with a note and a fault

notes.purpose: Intended to show a pen carrying both a note and an open equipment fault.
states: C1 has a note and an open fault (Drinking station: "Leaking valve at the east end.").

elements.name: Pen header · note icon
elements.logic: Visible, as on the walk.

elements.name: Pen header · fault
elements.logic: No fault mark is drawn on the list: penEntry() only knows the note. The fault appears only in the pen log after it is reported.

controls.does: opens the pen sheet; the sheet has no fault row

issues: The preset looks identical to the walk: an open equipment fault has no sign on the list and no row in the pen sheet.

Built in the code but no control in the prototype opens it (checked in the browser and by searching the code for a control with this action). This covers Equipment faults (pen-faults), Report fault, Resolve fault and the "Report equipment fault" pen chooser.

notes.purpose: Everything about one pen outside its pigs: the note, the feed guidance and the pen log. How to reach it: open the walk and tap a pen name.
states: With a note: a note card above the list (C1). Without a note: the row reads "Add pen note" (C2).

elements.name: Title · scope
elements.logic: Pen id; pig count of the whole pen; unit name.

elements.name: Note card
elements.shows: Close the aisle gate after passing. · G. Hansen · today · 06:40
elements.logic: Shown only when the pen has a note; author and time as saved ("today · 09:41" for notes saved in this session). Opens the full note.

elements.name: Row · Feed guidance
elements.logic: Formula name + feedLabel: allocation in kg, "Station-fed" or "Ad-lib".

elements.name: Row · pen note
elements.shows: Edit pen note / Add pen note
elements.logic: Title and subtitle change with whether a note exists ("Update the note for this pen" / "Leave information for the next person").

elements.name: Row · Pen log
elements.shows: Pen log · Transfers, health and notes
elements.logic: Always shown.

controls.does: opens the Pen feeding page (reading); its Adjust feed button opens the editor

edge: The note card is the only place a note's text is visible; the walk shows only an icon.
rules: Notes are attached to the pen, never recorded on its pigs (ROUND-3).
issues: Two doors to the pen's feed with different results: the feed value in the pen header opens the editor directly, the "Feed guidance" row here opens the reading page first.
The note is shown twice on this sheet (the note card and the "Edit pen note" row), and is copied into the pen log as "Pen note added".

notes.purpose: Read, add, edit or close the pen's note. How to reach it: pen sheet, then the note card or Add / Edit pen note.
states: Reading: note text, author line, Edit note (text button), Close note (primary).
Closed: "Closed · Kept in pen log", closer and time, and Undo close (disabled when a new note was written meanwhile).
Editing: one text area, Save note disabled while empty.

elements.name: Note text
elements.shows: Close the aisle gate after passing.
elements.logic: The current note, or the one just closed.

elements.name: Author line
elements.logic: Who and when the note was first added; an edit overwrites the author with the editor and "today · 09:41".

elements.name: Closed status
elements.logic: Only just after closing; the note leaves the pen and a log entry "Pen note closed" is added with the text and original author.

elements.name: Save note
elements.logic: Disabled while the text area is empty or blank.

controls.does: moves the note into the pen log and clears the pen
restores the note and logs "Pen note reopened"

edge: One note per pen: writing a new note replaces the text; the old text is kept only in the log.
Pen note can also be written for several pens at once from the Actions sheet (Pens tab).
issues: A pen holds one note; Close note and Edit note overlap (an edit replaces, a close archives), and there is no way to keep two notes.
Author is overwritten on edit, so the original author is lost from the card.

notes.purpose: The pen's activity: transfers, notes, equipment, health, feed. How to reach it: pen sheet, Pen log.
states: All activity / one category; all dates / Today / Last 7 days / Last 30 days / custom range; empty: "No activity recorded yet" or "No matching entries".

elements.name: Filter bar · category
elements.logic: Choices: All, Production, Health, Movement, Feed, Measurements, Notes, Equipment. Equipment is offered for the pen log only (not for a pig log).

elements.name: Filter bar · date
elements.logic: Opens the Date range drawer; shows "12 Sep" or "5 Sep–12 Sep" for a custom range.

elements.name: Result line
elements.logic: Count after both filters; Clear appears when a filter is on.

elements.name: Entry
elements.shows: type tag, title, note, "12 Sept 2026 · 06:40 · G. Hansen"
elements.logic: Grouped by date. The date comes from the entry; entries with no known date stay under their own label ("Before this walk"); dates are never invented.

elements.name: Entry · note text
elements.logic: For pen entries the pig ids that took part are appended to the note.

controls.does: opens the date drawer (presets or custom start/end; Apply disabled when start > end)

edge: Custom range needs both dates and end on or after start, otherwise "Choose a start and end date." or "End date must be on or after start date."
rules: ASTRA-LOG-FILTER-PATTERNS: one category filter and one date range; newest first.
issues: Category is inferred from the title for legacy entries (eventCategory), so a renamed title silently falls into Notes.
The same log component is used for the pig log (pig-profile.log); both carry the same filter bar.

notes.purpose: Narrow the walk to a production stage, a condition or a care level. How to reach it: the funnel button on the walk.
states: Default: all three read "All / Any". Reset clears the draft; Show pigs applies it.

elements.name: Production stage
elements.logic: Options are the stages found among the unit's pigs.

elements.name: Disease or symptom
elements.logic: Options are the condition names found on the unit's pigs.

elements.name: Care
elements.logic: No action needed · Monitor · Treat in place · Move to hospital pen.

controls.does: applies and returns to the walk

edge: Batch can be filtered but has no control here (set by the unreachable batch sheet).
issues: Batch, health status and manual-feed are part of the filter state but have no field in this sheet.
The Health lens and the condition/care filters overlap.

notes.purpose: Jump to a pen on the list by its place in the unit. How to reach it: Go to pen in the dock.
states: Four columns (A to D) by six rows; a pen with no matching pig is disabled and reads "Not in unit" or "No matches".

elements.name: Pen cell
elements.logic: Id and a one-line fact: "N health" when the pen has pigs with any condition (ongoing included), otherwise "N pigs".

elements.name: Current pen
elements.logic: The pen at the top of the list.

elements.name: Hold to peek
elements.shows: pop-up with pig count, feed, conditions, manual-feed pigs, note
elements.logic: Holding a cell 350 ms shows the preview without navigating. Same gesture as farrowing.

controls.does: closes the map and scrolls the list so the pen sits under the sticky controls

copy: Tap a pen to go to its pigs. Hold to peek. (raw)
edge: The filter stays on; a pen with no matching pig cannot be opened.
rules: Same four-column, six-row map as farrowing; positions are sample positions, not the real unit layout.
issues: "N health" counts ongoing conditions as well; nothing says it counts pigs.
The peek preview contains a fault line that is never filled (faults list is always empty in the code).
The audit marks the long-press as possibly unsuitable on mobile.

notes.purpose: Find a pig by ear tag or pen. How to reach it: Search or Scan ear tag in the dock.
states: Search: input "Ear tag or pen" and the result list.
Scan: the same plus "Camera scanning is not connected in this prototype." and a button "Try sample tag 000306".

elements.name: Result count
elements.logic: All pigs of the unit when the box is empty; filtered by tag or pen text as typed.

elements.name: Result row
elements.logic: Pen id and the raw stage name.

edge: No match: "No matching pigs in this unit."
rules: SEARCH-IDENTITY: search and scan are navigation aids, saving a record is the only write.
issues: Ear-notch search (named in the identity notes) is not here.
Scan and Search open nearly the same sheet.

notes.purpose: One action sheet for the ticked pigs or pens. Here two pigs (000254, 000267) are selected; the same sheet opens for one pig (see pig-profile.actions) or for pens.
states: Pigs selected, more than one: tabs Health and General at the foot; the Production group is hidden.
Pens ticked: a Pigs / Pens switch at the top; the Pens tab offers Pen note and Feed (see feed-plan.bulk).
Rows that do not apply move to "Unavailable actions (N)" with the reason.

elements.name: Title · scope
elements.logic: selectionLabel: "N pens · N pigs".

elements.name: Health · Disease or symptom
elements.logic: Shown when at least one selected pig is alive.

elements.name: Health · Record treatment
elements.logic: Same condition.

elements.name: Health · Edit conditions
elements.logic: Only for a selection of two or more AND at least one pig has a condition.

elements.name: Health · Resolve conditions · Care instructions
elements.shows: Recover or correct a finding · Monitor, treat or move
elements.logic: Only when a selected pig has a condition; otherwise listed as unavailable ("No open conditions to resolve." / "Record a health finding first.").

elements.name: General · Add a note
elements.shows: The same note for these pigs
elements.logic: Always for live pigs.

elements.name: General · Measurements & condition
elements.logic: Opens a small menu: Record body condition, Record weight (a separate value for each pig), Record backfat (sows and gilts only). Record temperature is offered for one pig only.

elements.name: General · Adjust feed
elements.logic: Shown when at least one selected pig can be fed (not ad-lib, not dead, has a plan); otherwise listed as unavailable with the reason.

elements.name: Footer tabs
elements.logic: Jump to a group; the active tab follows the scroll. Production is added for one pig only.

controls.control: Disease or symptom · Record treatment · Edit conditions · Resolve conditions · Care instructions
controls.does: open the health forms for the selected pigs
opens the feed editor for the selected pigs
lists the blocked rows with the reasons
lists the selection with Remove on each row

edge: Dead sows are not eligible for any action except a note.
Production actions are hidden for a multi-pig or pen selection so a group never receives a single-sow workflow.
Batch results: Save applies only to included, changed rows; an invalid entered value blocks the whole save.
rules: "Current task, including Farrowing: hidden in bulk" (ASTRA-BULK-ACTIONS).
One drawer shape for 1 or many pigs: list of pigs above, anchored controls and Save below.
Selecting a pen selects its pigs; there is no pen-level health or feed record.
issues: Health and General groups sit in one long scroll with tabs at the foot; two groups of three or four rows each do not need tabs.
"Edit conditions" (bulk only), "Resolve conditions" and "Care instructions" all edit a finding; three doors for one record.
"Measurements & condition" is a menu that holds body condition, which is a health record, next to weight and backfat.
The sheet header says only "2 pigs"; it does not name the pigs or pens.

notes.purpose: Check who is in the selection and remove anyone. How to reach it: View selected in the dock.
states: Pens group (when pens are ticked) and Pigs group; each row has a Remove button.

elements.name: Pig row
elements.logic: Raw stage name, not the stage-and-days text of the list.

elements.name: Pen row
elements.logic: Pen id and pig count.

edge: Removing the last pig closes the selection.
issues: Stage shown as "Gestating" while the list shows "Gestation".

notes.purpose: Everything recorded since the page opened. How to reach it: Log on the walk.
states: Empty: "No updates yet — Health findings, measurements and pen updates will appear here."
Each update: title, subjects, note, time and author.

elements.name: Update
elements.shows: Health recorded · 000267 · Thin · Monitor · 09:41 · G. Hansen
elements.logic: Every saved record adds one event (health, measurement, note, feed change, pen note, fault); the time is always 09:41 and the author G. Hansen in the prototype.

rules: The first review renamed "History" to "Updates this walk" (BLIND-REVIEW).
issues: The button is called Log, the aria-label "Updates this walk" and the sheet "This walk": three names.
The same events appear again in each pig's Log and the pen log.

notes.purpose: Check in to the unit to record that it was walked. How to reach it: Finish walk on the walk.
states: Before check-in: count of updates and one primary "Check in to Unit 7".

elements.name: Count
elements.logic: Number of updates saved in this walk.

elements.name: Statement
elements.shows: Check in as G. Hansen to record that you walked this unit. This does not mark every pig as healthy or every instruction as completed.
elements.logic: Fixed text.

rules: Check-in records only that the unit was walked.
issues: Walking all pens is not checked: check-in is allowed with nothing recorded and pens unseen.

notes.purpose: Confirmation after check-in. How to reach it: Finish walk, then Check in.
states: Single state.

elements.name: Mark and text
elements.shows: Checked in at 09:41 · G. Hansen · Unit 7 · 0 updates recorded
elements.logic: Time fixed at 09:41; the update count is the walk's event count ("1 update" singular).

controls.does: returns to the walk, which now reads "Check in again" and last check-in 09:41

issues: Two back controls (the header Back and the primary "Back to unit") do the same thing.

notes.purpose: Designed to give the unit a summary above the list: pig and pen counts, open equipment faults, latest sensor readings and the batch tracker. In the prototype the card exists in code only and is not drawn.
states: Sensors present: three readings (Temperature 22.4 °C, Humidity 64 %, Ammonia 8 ppm NH3), updated 09:40.

elements.name: Unit button
elements.shows: Unit 7 with grid icon and chevron
elements.logic: Would open the unit sheet (Environment and Equipment).

elements.name: Faults chip
elements.logic: Only when a pen has an open fault; counts open faults in all pens.

elements.name: Population
elements.logic: Total pigs and pens in the unit.

elements.name: Environment strip
elements.logic: Value is "—" when the reading is null; unit label "ppm NH3" for ammonia. Sensors with installed:false are left out.

elements.name: Sensor empty line
elements.logic: When no sensor is installed.

edge: Environmental values are absent, not zero (ROUND-3).
rules: Sensor card should show source, freshness and trend once real readings exist (ROUND-3).
issues: The unit summary card (unitOverview in the code) is built but never placed on the walk, so this preset renders the same list as inspection.walk. What the card would show is described on inspection.sensors.
The whole unit summary has no way onto the screen; either draw it or remove the code.

screens.name: Unit summary · no sensors

notes.purpose: The unit has no sensors installed.

elements.name: Sensor empty line
elements.logic: Shown instead of the environment strip.

issues: The unit summary card (unitOverview in the code) is built but never placed on the walk, so this preset renders the same list as inspection.walk. What the card would show is described on inspection.sensors.

screens.name: Unit summary · a sensor with no reading
screens.zh: 单元概览 · 传感器无读数

elements.name: Metric
elements.logic: A null value renders as a dash with the label kept, marked is-unavailable.

edge: An unavailable sensor is not removed and not shown as 0.
issues: The unit summary card (unitOverview in the code) is built but never placed on the walk, so this preset renders the same list as inspection.walk. What the card would show is described on inspection.sensors.

notes.purpose: The unit has no batches; the batch tracker section is left out.

elements.name: Pig record · Batch / Next task
elements.logic: Empty facts show a dash.

edge: Batch membership then offers "No production batches are available." as an unavailable action.

notes.purpose: The unit has one batch (20) in pens C1 and C2; pen D4 is removed.

rules: Several current production tasks can run for one batch; each pig sees the one that applies to her.
issues: The unit summary card (unitOverview in the code) is built but never placed on the walk, so this preset differs only in the stage text. What the card would show is described on inspection.sensors.

notes.purpose: Readings and open equipment faults for the whole unit. Built in the code but no control in the prototype opens it (checked in the browser and by searching the code for a control with this action).
states: Environment: grid of readings (Temperature, Humidity, Ammonia), each with its time or "Reading unavailable"; "No sensors installed" when empty.
Equipment faults: "N open" and one card per fault; empty: "No open equipment faults".

elements.name: Reading
elements.logic: Value or "—"; the line under it is the update time or "Reading unavailable".

elements.name: Fault card
elements.shows: Pen C2 · Open · Drinking station · Drinker valve leaking on the east side. · Reported 06:40 · G. Hansen
elements.logic: One per open fault across all pens.

issues: Also exists as separate sheets "Environment" and "Equipment faults" with the same content.
Fault cards are read-only here; reporting and resolving live in the pen fault sheets, which are also unreachable.

notes.purpose: One batch: stage, pigs, pens, task tracker, and a way to filter the walk by it. Built in the code but no control in the prototype opens it (checked in the browser and by searching the code for a control with this action).
states: Single state.

elements.name: Scope
elements.logic: Stage, pig count, unit.

elements.name: Batch tracker
elements.shows: Pregnancy check · 5 pigs · Next · Tomorrow · 13 Sep
elements.logic: Running tasks with "N pigs · N days in progress" or the next task with its date.

elements.name: Pens
elements.logic: Pens that hold the batch.

controls.does: filters the walk to the batch

rules: Opening a batch offers a deliberate filter; swiping does not silently change the list (ROUND-3).
issues: The batch carousel and square batch cards described in ROUND-3 no longer exist in the code.

notes.purpose: Open faults in one pen with Report fault. Built in the code but no control in the prototype opens it (checked in the browser and by searching the code for a control with this action).
states: Faults listed: one row per open fault (device, description); none: "No open faults".

elements.name: Fault row
elements.shows: Drinking station · Drinker valve leaking on the east side.
elements.logic: Open faults of the pen only.

rules: A fault belongs to one device in one pen.
issues: No pen-level control opens this sheet.

notes.purpose: Report a device fault in one pen. Built in the code but no control in the prototype opens it (checked in the browser and by searching the code for a control with this action).
states: Device chosen from Feeding station / Drinking station / Other equipment; "Other" adds a device name field.
Save disabled until device and description are filled (and the name when Other).

elements.name: Device
elements.logic: Choosing a device that already has an open fault opens that fault instead of a duplicate.

elements.name: Description
elements.shows: What is broken or not working?
elements.logic: Required.

controls.does: saves and returns to the sheet that opened it

edge: Saving an already-open device opens the existing fault.

notes.purpose: Read one fault and resolve it with an optional note. Built in the code but no control in the prototype opens it (checked in the browser and by searching the code for a control with this action).
states: Open: description, who and when, optional "Resolution note", Resolve fault.
Resolved: "Resolved 09:41 · G. Hansen" and the note.

elements.name: Fault
elements.shows: Drinking station · Pen C2 · Open fault · Reported 06:40 · G. Hansen
elements.logic: Name, state, description and reporter.

controls.does: closes the fault and logs "Fault resolved"
